races.name: Betfair Backs Opinions Superior Mile Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
NEEDLE MATCH found the 2000 Guineas coming too soon in his development but he got his career firmly back on track with an eye-catching second in a Group 3 at Leopardstown last month so he shades the vote over fellow 3-y-o Hankelow, who has had valid excuses since his excellent third in the French 2000 Guineas. Decent claims can also be made for Persica and The Lost King.

  1. NEEDLE MATCH
  2. HANKELOW (IRE)
  3. PERSICA (IRE)

races.name: Betfair Celebrates Bow Echo Ascendant Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
ROCKET BOY cemented a really positive start to his career when a keeping-on third at this listed level at Salisbury 3 weeks ago. That sets a pretty good standard and with the prospect of more to come, he looks the answer. First Law is open to any amount of improvement, however, while Rafe's Da Man has raced 4 times but is going the right way, too.

  1. ROCKET BOY (IRE)
  2. FIRST LAW (IRE)
  3. RAFE'S DA MAN

races.name: Best Odds On The Betfair Exchange Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A useful handicap that seems sure to prove strong form. GALILEAN QUALITY shaped notably well in sustaining his run from a long way back when runner-up in the Melrose at York a fortnight ago and still looks on good mark following a 5 lb rise. Asia Force, a stablemate of the selection, immediately showed the benefit of a gelding operation when a dominant winner at Carlisle and could have more to offer, with Bridge of Eagles also of interest upped markedly in trip.

  1. GALILEAN QUALITY (IRE)
  2. ASIA FORCE (IRE)
  3. BRIDGE OF EAGLES (IRE)

races.name: Betfair Exchange Old Borough Cup Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
There's a feeling at least one of the unexposed sorts will come to the fore. AEGEAN PRINCE hasn't been seen since finishing second in a French listed event at the end of last October but he romped home in an Ascot novice after a similar length of absence last year and he's preferred to Finalise and Kissmehoneyhoney, whose trainer William Haggas has won this twice in recent years. Ian Williams is also no stranger to success in this contest and his Hermetic completes the shortlist.

  1. AEGEAN PRINCE
  2. FINALISE
  3. KISSMEHONEYHONEY

races.name: Betfair Sprint Cup Stakes (Group 1)
races.verdict:
PABORUS impressed when beating Marvelman in the Chipchase over 6f at Newcastle on his reappearance. He was behind that same rival in the recent City of York over 7f but was still bang there entering the final furlong and can get the better of Andrew Balding's charge back sprinting. Next on the list is Almeraq, whose overall record suggests he'll bounce back from a lesser effort in the July Cup, particularly given how well he handles ease in the ground.

  1. PABORUS
  2. MARVELMAN (IRE)
  3. ALMERAQ

races.name: Betfair Be Friendly Handicap
races.verdict:
A case can be made for a few of these but TRILBY hasn't looked back since the cheekpieces went on and is fancied to garner a fourth victory of 2026, with conditions right in his favour at a track he goes well at. Elara May is feared most on the back of a very good Yarmouth second, although Arklow Lad and Advertised can both play a prominent role too.

  1. TRILBY
  2. ELARA MAY
  3. ARKLOW LAD (IRE)

races.name: HKJC World Pool Handicap
races.verdict:
BRIGHTON BOY has an impressive record under these sort of conditions and he gets the vote in an open-looking handicap. The David O'Meara pair both make appeal from falling marks with Darkness preferred of the 2, while Star Anthem could prove well treated if back on song.

  1. BRIGHTON BOY (IRE)
  2. DARKNESS (FR)
  3. STAR ANTHEM (IRE)

races.name: Betfair.Betfair Handicap
races.verdict:
CROWN OFFICE decisively beat some good rivals on his only prior outing on soft and he can step forward from an excellent second at Nottingham to get off the mark for the year. The progressive The Sweet Escape and reliable Military Leader also merit strong consideration.

  1. CROWN OFFICE
  2. THE SWEET ESCAPE
  3. MILITARY LEADER

races.name: Personal Touches Day Of Elegance Nursery
races.verdict:
EMPIRE RISING won readily at Beverley and may well follow up on return to a nursery. Improving Love Tanya is feared, along with The Monkey King, who should relish this step up in trip. Coco Nova completes the shortlist in a competitive-looking opener.

  1. EMPIRE RISING (IRE)
  2. LOVE TANYA (IRE)
  3. THE MONKEY KING

races.name: JW4x4 Northallerton Nursery
races.verdict:
ANCHIANO's Yarmouth form has been well advertised, and he's taken to resume winning ways on nursery debut. Savage Mariner is on a handy mark if he can recapture his debut form with sights lowered, while Concert Pitch has to be respected now up and running.

  1. ANCHIANO (IRE)
  2. SAVAGE MARINER (IRE)
  3. CONCERT PITCH (IRE)

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MA BLUSHIN ROSIE showed plenty amidst inexperience when third at Carlisle on her recent debut and, with improvement on the cards, is taken to strike at the second time of asking. Dontlookanyfurther shoulders a penalty for his Redcar success but is likely to progress further, while newcomer Pippy Boy makes some appeal on paper and warrants a market check.

  1. MA BLUSHIN ROSIE (IRE)
  2. DONTLOOKANYFURTHER (IRE)
  3. PIPPY BOY (IRE)

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
A competitive fillies' handicap but OOLONG POOBONG signalled she is ready to strike again when an excellent third in a big-field York handicap at the Ebor meeting and looks the way to go. Cotai Belle seems sure to go well but could once more have to settle for runner-up spot, while Perfect Part and Proposal can also have a say.

  1. OOLONG POOBONG (IRE)
  2. COTAI BELLE (IRE)
  3. PERFECT PART (IRE)

races.name: Rudding Park Harrogate Handicap
races.verdict:
COMMANCHE FALLS is a long time without a victory but has slipped to an attractive mark and could prove the way to go on the back of his good recent Ripon third. The Good Biscuit is feared most as he bids for a fourth success in his last five outings, while Fivethousandtoone and Dark Cloud Rising can both have a say too if things drop right for them.

  1. COMMANCHE FALLS
  2. THE GOOD BISCUIT
  3. FIVETHOUSANDTOONE (IRE)

races.name: Calverts Carpets Hambleton Cup Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
WARDLAW comes with a health warning, but he's talented and may well follow up his breakthrough victory at Beverley. What's The Plan is feared most tackling 1½m for the first time. High Storm and Bay of Myths are others to consider in a competitive handicap for the grade.

  1. WARDLAW (USA)
  2. WHAT'S THE PLAN
  3. HIGH STORM

races.name: Thirsk Racecourse Ideal Conference & Events Venue Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
FRANKIES DREAM let himself down at the start at Redcar last time but he's very hard to ignore having been given a real chance by the assessor, so is worth chancing to belatedly get off the mark for the season. Misunderstood went close to landing a first success for current yard at Beverley last week and is an obvious player from a 2 lb higher mark, while Native Instinct completes the shortlist.

  1. FRANKIES DREAM (IRE)
  2. MISUNDERSTOOD (FR)
  3. NATIVE INSTINCT

races.name: Thirsk Racecourse Ideal Conference & Events Venue Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
The suggestion is NYMAN, whose last 2 runs have strongly suggested he's coming to the boil. Obelix was unlucky not to have gone close at Beverley last month having suffered significant interference and must enter calculations, along with Mr King, who's holding his form well at present.

  1. NYMAN (IRE)
  2. OBELIX
  3. MR KING (IRE)

races.name: quinnbet.com Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
JUJUBELLA has a pretty good record here, including second in a competitive race over this trip on her latest visit in June. Recobella arrives at the top of her game and is second choice ahead of Princess Nyla.

  1. JUJUBELLA (IRE)
  2. RECOBELLA (FR)
  3. PRINCESS NIYLA

races.name: QuinnBet Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
races.verdict:
There's definitely more to come from NIFFLER, particularly now stepping up to 2m, and he can make it 3-3 in handicaps. Thursday's Lingfield runner-up Ada Rose may be the one to follow Sir Mark Prescott's charge home.

  1. NIFFLER (GER)
  2. ADA ROSE
  3. LILYKOY

races.name: QuinnBet Extra Place Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
John Butler's FOXY NIGHT holds the clear edge on form and is taken to gain a deserved breakthrough success at the chief expense of Reformation who can build on his debut win in a Salisbury match. Regal Desire also looks to have better days ahead of her and can have a say, too.

  1. FOXY NIGHT (IRE)
  2. REFORMATION
  3. REGAL DESIRE (FR)

races.name: Christmas Parties At Newcastle Racecourse Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The market should prove highly informative but the vote goes to Kodiac colt GEOMETRY who is bred to be well above average and hails from the in-form Roger Varian yard. Fellow newcomer Crystal Dark also appeals on paper and could emerge as the main danger ahead of the more experienced Mr Minz.

  1. GEOMETRY
  2. CRYSTAL DARK
  3. MR MINZ (IRE)

races.name: Mini Golf At High Gosforth Park Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
Not the easiest race to assess but it could prove worth siding with LADY KODIAC who returns to an artificial surface after a break on a lenient-looking mark and can bag a third all-weather victory. Dark Angel Light has an absence to overcome but remains unexposed starting out for Julie Camacho and could emerge as the chief threat ahead of Ormolulu.

  1. LADY KODIAC (IRE)
  2. DARK ANGEL LIGHT (IRE)
  3. ORMOLULU (IRE)

races.name: Download The Racecourse App Raceday Ready Handicap
races.verdict:
The likeable GREAT PROFIT can defy a 7 lb higher mark and follow up from last month's Thirsk success. Believeinmenow has largely held his form this season and the reapplication of a hood looks a positive move, so he is also shortlisted alongside Sea Her Excel.

  1. GREAT PROFIT (IRE)
  2. BELIEVEINMENOW (IRE)
  3. SEA HER EXCEL

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
SUNRISEONTHEBOYNE is effectively racing off the same mark from which he defied on Wednesday and can complete a quick-fire double. Jamaican Storm and Wish This, 1-2 over C&D at the end of July, can complete the placings.

  1. SUNRISEONTHEBOYNE (IRE)
  2. JAMAICAN STORM
  3. WISH THIS

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Top-weight ANTHROPOLOGIST looks a solid option on the back of a couple of good in-frame efforts at Southwell. War Howl is very interesting from such a low mark if able to build on a more encouraging effort at Doncaster, whilst Coramento was seen to good effect when scoring here 5 weeks ago but can't be discounted after a 7 lb rise.

  1. ANTHROPOLOGIST
  2. WAR HOWL (IRE)
  3. CORAMENTO

races.name: attheraces.com Handicap
races.verdict:
STARLINER rates the pick of the weights racing off the same mark as when a very close recent C&D second, so he gets the vote over course specialist Second Fiddle, who returns to her favoured venue in good nick after a spell on the turf. Ey Up He's A Star also has winning form around here and can play a prominent role, too.

  1. STARLINER (IRE)
  2. SECOND FIDDLE (IRE)
  3. EY UP HE'S A STAR

races.name: William Hill Epic Boost Fillies' Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
GREEK SYMPHONY won her previous outing on the all-weather and has acquitted herself well on turf the last 2 starts, including behind a subsequent winner last time, so any progress for this step up to 1m could mean she's hard to beat. Recent winners Woodhay Wayfarer and Forest Berry both come here on the up and look sure to be in the mix, too.

  1. GREEK SYMPHONY
  2. WOODHAY WAYFARER (IRE)
  3. FOREST BERRY

races.name: William Hill London Mile Series Final Handicap
races.verdict:
CAVOLO NERO made light of a difficult tactical position when winning readily over C&D 17 days ago on his first start for new connections and is fancied to defy a 5 lb rise in this stronger contest. Victory Ace is thriving with 3 consecutive all-weather wins, the latest an impressive success at this track, and is hard to rule out despite a 10 lb rise in the weights, while Warrior Mode may have more progress in him, too.

  1. CAVOLO NERO
  2. VICTORY ACE
  3. WARRIOR MODE

races.name: William Hill September Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
GETHIN is quite a keen goer but his near miss in a French listed race last autumn shows he has the stamina for 1½m and he can bounce back from his below-par run in the Eclipse and prove too strong for Pride of Arras and Tornado Alert. Outstanding hurdler Constitution Hill showed enough in 2 all-weather wins in the spring to think he can make his presence felt in Group races on the Flat.

  1. GETHIN (IRE)
  2. PRIDE OF ARRAS (IRE)
  3. TORNADO ALERT (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Sirenia Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
TAWAKAL has made a highly-encouraging start to his career and has the scope and pedigree to go on progressing now upped in grade, so he's an appealing candidate. Moonrise shaded a tight finish to land the Princess Margaret Stakes at Ascot 6 weeks ago and is much respected under a 3-lb penalty. Adaay of Scarlett underperformed in the Gimcrack last time but sets the standard on his previous form.

  1. TAWAKAL (FR)
  2. MOONRISE (IRE)
  3. ADAAY OF SCARLETT (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Price Boosts Every Day Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
VEIL OF CLOUDS made a mockery of her mark when winning at Lingfield 19 days ago and looks capable of defying an 8 lb rise. Shallow returns to a C&D where twice successful and ran to the pick of her form when second at Newmarket recently so may prove next best, while Rumble Ruby would likely have won at Yarmouth had she kept straight and warrants respect back at 6f.

  1. VEIL OF CLOUDS
  2. SHALLOW
  3. RUMBLE RUBY

races.name: William Hill Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
PRIMO LARA has made a good start since returning to this yard and shaped as if better than the result when fourth at York last time. He still looks well treated returned to the all-weather and could prove too good for course specialist Whitcombe Rockstar. Topteam is one that needs considering on return from 3 months off given he's already scored when fresh at this venue this year.

  1. PRIMO LARA (IRE)
  2. WHITCOMBE ROCKSTAR
  3. TOPTEAM (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Keep Your Raceday Positive Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
FLASH KOZO found only a fellow upwardly mobile one too good at Wolverhampton last time and remains a 3-y-o to keep on the right side. An Bradan Feasa deserves full marks for consistency and seems sure to be thereabouts once more, while Naval Tribute is another to bear in mind for all that he had plenty in his favour on his most recent outing.

  1. FLASH KOZO (IRE)
  2. AN BRADAN FEASA (IRE)
  3. NAVAL TRIBUTE

races.name: Schweppes Handicap
races.verdict:
Upwardly-mobile 3-y-o THUNDER CALL brings a different profile to the table to the rest of these and assuming he gets the 7f trip, he'll take plenty of stopping. Northern Express and Two Tribes are battle-hardened handicappers but both have won over C&D in the past and head the dangers.

  1. THUNDER CALL
  2. NORTHERN EXPRESS (IRE)
  3. TWO TRIBES

races.name: tote.co.uk Money Back 2nd Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
HEYZOOM went a long way towards proving himself a well-handicapped horse when fourth at Royal Ascot (strong form) and he can confirm that impression here returned to calmer waters. Archers Bay must be respected given the manner of his C&D win at the Shergar Cup, while Into The Light is another potential threat if bouncing back under Toby Moore.

  1. HEYZOOM (IRE)
  2. ARCHERS BAY (IRE)
  3. INTO THE LIGHT

races.name: tote 75k Guaranteed Placepot Today EBF 'Confined' Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A small field but it's not short on potential, with DANNAHUE, Pensando A Te and Asheyra all showing enough on debut to think they can win races. The first-named gets a narrow vote here, with the Charlie Appleby 2-y-os continuing to operate at a very healthy strike-rate.

  1. DANNAHUE (IRE)
  2. PENSANDO A TE
  3. ASHEYRA (IRE)

races.name: Silent Pool Gin 'Confined' Handicap
races.verdict:
A well bred and lightly-raced 3-y-o, GAVRIEL fits the typical profile of a Cambridgeshire contender from this yard, and a win here would provide a massive qualification boost for that upcoming target. Law Court remains on a steady upward curve and is a clear second choice.

  1. GAVRIEL
  2. LAW COURT (IRE)
  3. KAHIN (IRE)

races.name: Download The tote App British EBF Premier Fillies' Handicap (Str)
races.verdict:
ROSA INGLESA was value extra when beating Nanino Niyati over C&D in July, so Charlie Fellowes' 3-y-o is taken to uphold the form off similar terms. Seren Star was a close third in the Kensington Palace here on her penultimate start so she is another to consider, along with the progressive Luna Celeste.

  1. ROSA INGLESA
  2. NANINO NIYATI
  3. SEREN STAR (IRE)

races.name: Club26 Handicap
races.verdict:
GOLDEN LONG has already had a fine 2026 upon his transfer from Hong Kong and given he was value for extra over the winning distance at Doncaster 3 weeks ago, a further 4 lb rise may well be within range. Clive Cox has a couple of interesting contenders in Fast Track Harry and Diligently, with Sword also of some interest.

  1. GOLDEN LONG (AUS)
  2. FAST TRACK HARRY
  3. DILIGENTLY

races.name: tote.co.uk For Racing & Sports Betting Handicap
races.verdict:
Plenty to consider but DYONISOS was a big eyecatcher at Goodwood last month so he looks the way to go. The assessor has been very fair with Glamorous Breeze and she's dangerous if getting into her usual rhythm, with Fluorescence and Manatee Mehmas also of interest.

  1. DYONISOS (FR)
  2. GLAMOROUS BREEZE
  3. FLUORESCENCE

races.name: Power Utilities Group Conditional Jockeys' Selling Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
AT THE OCHE can capitalise on a lower hurdles mark to make it 2 wins from 3 since joining the Skeltons. Mojo Ego and Raffles Nobu are most likely to fill the places.

  1. AT THE OCHE (IRE)
  2. MOJO EGO (IRE)
  3. RAFFLES NOBU (FR)

races.name: What The Frunk: The Geely EX2 Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PIONEER PETE, King's Scholar and Gambino all shoulder double penalties, but the first-named runner has achieved easily the most to date and is hard to oppose. The switch to conventional hurdles is a likely plus for King's Scholar given he hasn't looked the most natural in the jumping department and he's feared most.

  1. PIONEER PETE
  2. KING'S SCHOLAR (IRE)
  3. GAMBINO (IRE)

races.name: Allan Atkinson Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
A tough call to split C&D winners LORD OF THE GLANCE and Jet Patrol, but Alex Hales' charge just gets the nod following an eye-catching comeback at Cartmel last week.

  1. LORD OF THE GLANCE
  2. JET PATROL (IRE)
  3. MAYDAY GAMES (IRE)

races.name: Wynchwood Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CAPTAIN COOL might be good for a fourth course success of the season. Last week's Newton Abbot scorer gets the nod for the forecast spot.

  1. CAPTAIN COOL (IRE)
  2. BREAKING COVER (IRE)
  3. SIR TIVO (FR)

races.name: Rich Ellis's 60th Vinyl Countdown Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
PORTER IN THE PARK could offer some each-way value in race where a few have something to prove. She's narrowly preferred to Roaring Home, who arrives in the form of her life but does have a career-high mark to overcome. Notnowlinda and Jackstell are feared if back on song.

  1. PORTER IN THE PARK (IRE)
  2. ROARING HOME
  3. NOTNOWLINDA (IRE)

races.name: Envesca Safety Champions Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
DANNY'S FRIEND resumed winning ways in impressive fashion at Newton Abbot in June and, with the extra distance potentially triggering further improvement, a 7 lb higher mark may not be enough to prevent the follow up. Jack Doyen was still going with zest when unseating his rider here recently and remains one to bear in mind now he's seemingly a reformed character, while the strong-travelling Huckleberry Sting is also respected as a last-time-out scorer.

  1. DANNY'S FRIEND (IRE)
  2. JACK DOYEN (IRE)
  3. HUCKLEBERRY STING

races.name: Andy Townsend Memorial Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
The addition of a first-time tongue strap could benefit BLACKWATER LILLY, who is fairly treated on her best form, so she's awarded the tentative nod. Mistral Blue can do better back in this company and may be the main danger. Parikarma and Sadies Diamond are honourable mentions.

  1. BLACKWATER LILLY
  2. MISTRAL BLUE
  3. PARIKARMA (IRE)

races.name: Irish EBF Auction Series Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
YOUR A DAISY makes plenty of appeal on debut, being a half-sister to several winners and representing a yard capable of readying one first time out. The booking of Wayne Lordan looks a sign of intent and she is worth siding with to make a winning debut. Roeillaun deserves extra credit for doing easily the best of those who raced in the smaller group at Naas 13 days ago and can be competitive, while Ana Morello took a step forward from her debut last time.

  1. YOUR A DAISY (IRE)
  2. ROEILLAUN (IRE)
  3. ANA MORELLO (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Nursery Handicap (Birdcatcher Series)
races.verdict:
SUPREME LORD was much improved when dropped back to sprinting on his handicap debut at this C&D 9 days ago, winning by 3¾ lengths, and can defy a 12 lb rise to follow up. Howlin Wolf chased him home that day and is entitled to get a good deal closer off these revised terms, while Lars Soldier should be better suited by the return to sprinting having struggled at longer trips.

  1. SUPREME LORD (IRE)
  2. HOWLIN WOLF (IRE)
  3. LARS SOLDIER (IRE)

races.name: Navan Racing Festival Early Bird Tickets On Sale Now Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
ROSATO wasn't at her best last time but has twice gone close off similar marks already this season and, with 2 successes at this course to her name, she looks worth chancing to come good in an open sprint. Irish Rumour arrives on the back of an encouraging effort and looks the biggest danger from a handy mark, whilst both course-specialist Step Back In Time and the in-form Simmering Seas are also feared.

  1. ROSATO (IRE)
  2. IRISH RUMOUR (IRE)
  3. STEP BACK IN TIME (IRE)

races.name: Christmas Parties At Navan Racecourse On 6th & 13th December Handicap
races.verdict:
NAMIID won over this C&D in May and is taken to build on some solid handicap efforts and resume winning ways back at this venue. Moltophino shaped well last time and is feared most from what looks a workable mark, while the thriving Amiata is also respected.

  1. NAMIID (IRE)
  2. MOLTOPHINO (IRE)
  3. AMIATA (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
Plenty of strong contenders from the leading yards, with MY SHAYLA getting the vote having lost out on the nod to one who got first run at Leopardstown recently. Joyous Heart, Flower Forest and Nautic Star are prominent among the dangers.

  1. MY SHAYLA (IRE)
  2. JOYOUS HEART (IRE)
  3. FLOWER FOREST (IRE)

races.name: Return Of The Jumps At Navan Racecourse September 19th Handicap (0-60) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
MAKE THE TIDE took a big step forward when gaining a first win in some style here on Wednesday and still looks ahead of her mark despite shouldering a 7 lb penalty, with this step up in trip also a likely plus. Cause I Like You heads the list of dangers on the back of a good Cork second, while Nephin Mountain, Alto Sax and Pallatine Hills also need considering in this competitive handicap.

  1. MAKE THE TIDE (IRE)
  2. CAUSE I LIKE YOU (IRE)
  3. NEPHIN MOUNTAIN (IRE)

races.name: Return Of The Jumps At Navan Racecourse September 19th Handicap (0-60) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
MILLHONE has been knocking on the door and can deservedly get her head in front for the first time. Nibras Rainbow has had a productive summer and should figure again. Connova also makes the shortlist along with Morning Approach for in-form Wille McCreery.

  1. MILLHONE (IRE)
  2. NIBRAS RAINBOW (IRE)
  3. CONNOVA (IRE)

races.name: Lynn Lodge Stud Maiden
races.verdict:
HANDANI has been placed in some strong maidens and can surely win one. This looks a good opening. Royal Bones can go well again, while Camelot Queen, clearly one of the lesser lights at Ballydoyle, should be in the hunt for the places.

  1. HANDANI (IRE)
  2. ROYAL BONES (IRE)
  3. CAMELOT QUEEN (IRE)
